scientific_integrity: The uniform integer recurrence and reduced persistence bars follow from an exact chain count and the published wedge-of-spheres theorem. All integral homology is torsion-free; finite verification is independent corroboration, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the proper Boolean lattice and nonequivariant rank-span filtration; no canonical equivariant bases or arbitrary geometric semilattice formula. The wedge existence and rank-span-two case are already known; independent novelty verification remains unperformed.
title: Complete integral persistence of rank-span filtered proper Boolean lattices
